BillHeading.BriefDescription: Concerning the safety and security of retail marijuana outlets.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the safety and security of retail marijuana outlets; amending RCW 9.94A.832; and adding a new section to chapter 69.50 RCW.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. A new section is added to chapter 69.50 RCW to read as follows:
BillSection.P: (1) A law enforcement agency must forward the offense report regarding any incident of robbery in the first or second degree of a retail outlet to the Washington state patrol within ten days of making the report if there is probable cause to believe that an offense has been committed, unless the case is under active investigation.

(2) The Washington state patrol must provide details of incidents of robbery in the first or second degree of a retail outlet to the board, within ten days of the state patrol's receipt of a report under subsection (1) of this section.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 2. RCW 9.94A.832 and 2013 c 270 s 1 are each amended to read as follows:Special allegation—Robbery in the first or second degree—Robbery of a pharmacy—Procedures.
BillSection.P: (1) the defendant has been convicted of robbery in the first degree or robbery in the second degree; and
(2) there has been a special allegation pleaded and proven beyond a reasonable doubt that the defendant committed a robbery of:
(1) A pharmacy as defined in RCW 18.64.011(21); or

P.TextRun: (2) A marijuana retail outlet, licensed under chapter 69.50 RCW, and the defendant committed the robbery as a premeditated act in concert with another individual or individuals;

BillSection.P: the court shall make a finding of fact of the special allegation, or if a jury is had, the jury shall, if it finds the defendant guilty, also find a special verdict as to the special allegation.

RevNote.NoteP: *Reviser's note: RCW 18.64.011 was alphabetized pursuant to RCW 1.08.015(2)(k), changing subsection (21) to subsection (26).
